title: Minder personal preparation relevance annotation row
description: Design proposal, not a trained model or observed employment dataset. Market attractiveness is excluded from relevance_grade.

profile_group_id.description: Keep related profiles and synthetic template variants in one split group.

relevance_grade.description: 0 weak,1 plausible with preparation,2 strong preparation relevance for defined horizon. Team reviewed, excludes market attractiveness.

skill_coverage.description: Weighted coverage among assessed required skills; null when none assessed.

interest_alignment.description: Reviewed alignment of explicit interests with the role; use a fixed rubric.

project_relevance.description: Relevance of supplied project evidence; absent evidence is unknown, not proven inability.

work_style_alignment.description: Alignment of stated work preferences with reviewed role characteristics.

time_feasibility.description: min(1, available preparation hours / required effort); known zero required effort gives 1.

resource_feasibility.description: Reviewed feasibility of the initial tasks given available resources; not intrinsic ability.

critical_prerequisite_coverage.description: Assessed coverage of reviewed prerequisites for the first milestone.

assessed_requirement_fraction.description: Weighted share of role requirements assessed; report separately as evidence coverage.
